simvars.name: PLANE ALTITUDE
simvars.description: The altitude of the aircraft above mean sea level. This value is referenced against the standard WGS84 ellipsoid and is the primary altitude reading used for navigation and autopilot operations.

simvars.name: GROUND ALTITUDE
simvars.description: The altitude of the terrain directly beneath the aircraft above mean sea level. This reflects the ground elevation at the aircraft's current horizontal position and is independent of aircraft altitude.

simvars.name: ENGINE RPM
simvars.description: The revolutions per minute of the indexed engine. For piston engines this reflects crankshaft speed; for turbine engines this reflects the N2 shaft speed unless otherwise specified.

simvars.name: AIRSPEED TRUE CALIBRATE
simvars.description: The calibration offset applied to the true airspeed indicator, expressed as a delta from the computed true airspeed. This value allows instrument calibration corrections to be applied to the true airspeed readout.

simvars.name: ENG COMBUSTION
simvars.description: Indicates whether combustion is occurring in the indexed engine. Returns 1 if the engine is currently producing combustion (i.e., the engine is running and fuel is igniting), and 0 otherwise.
